question: Should every moved (up or down) aspect row cite its evidence: a test, fixture, measurement or HR id?

options.label: Cite, and file nen check (Recommended)
options.consequence: canon requires a citation on every moved row; an NN issue asks body-check to refuse an uncited moved row

options.label: Cite, canon only
options.consequence: the citation rule lives in canon with no machine check

options.label: No evidence rule
options.consequence: keep the one-line why; only the aspect list changes

typed: Let's cite and provide evidence as possible, depending on the repository and on the scope of work, of course.
